# Plugin Star Radar · dsh-plugin-star-radar
A "what should I install?" reference for people new to DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
It answers one question: **which DSH plugins are people actually paying attention to and installing?
answers one question: **which DSH plugins are people actually paying attention to and installing?**

- Ranked by **GitHub stars**;
- Every card also shows **npm downloads over the last 30 days**, and y
Once listed, a plugin **stays listed** even after it falls below both thresholds: it moves to a labe
lled `已跌出 · 保留` group for `retainDays` (180 by default) with its last measured numbers, so it is sti
ll findable months later.
## Why two metrics
| Downloads only | Stars only | Both |
| Older plugins get pushed out by newer download spikes and become hard to find | A brand-new plugin
that is installed in bulk but not starred yet is missed | What people keep watching *and* what gets
installed right now |
Inclusion is the **union**; ranking is stars-first. A plugin that cools down stays on the page, whic
h is exactly what a reference list needs.

## What the page does

- **Groups** by star band (★ 5k+ / ★ 3k+ / download-only) so the tiers are obvious at a glance;
- **

Search** across name, package, description and category;
- **Category filter** from the market index
listed, listing date, Node/DSH ranges, OS/CPU, package size, permission notes, manual install comma

nd, repo links;
- **One-click install** through the official `pluginManager.installBundle`, falling
back to the profile's pnpm with a copyable manual command.

## Where the data comes from
| Data | Source |
| plugin list, GitHub stars, 30-day downloads, category, description, icon | `https://awesome-dsh-pl

ugin.com/plugins.json` — **one** request for everything |
| Node/DSH ranges, `os`/`cpu`, install scr
ipts, package size | `https://registry.npmjs.org/<pkg>/latest`, only for listed plugins |
Two deliberate choices:
1. **No per-package npm downloads history calls.** `api.npmjs.org/downloads/range` answers HTTP 429
under bursts, which is what made an earlier version of this plugin stall mid-refresh. One catalog re

quest cannot rate-limit itself.
2. **Manifest reads are optional and budgeted.** Missing notes never

-limit itself.
